LDSQ.description: Loading Sequence (LDSQ). A single record (key 1) whose LCNAME_ITEM lists static load case names in the order they are applied; the handler resolves each name to its STLD key and stores the ordered sequence.

LCNAME_ITEM.description: Ordered list of static load case (STLD) names defining the loading sequence. Each name must match an existing static load case; order is significant.
